A closer look at Valmectin Super.

The product is positioned around mixed internal and external parasite-care needs in farm animals. A useful parasite-control discussion considers which parasites are relevant, the animal’s exposure and the timing of assessment, rather than assuming that a broad product description covers every infestation.

What is in the formulation?

ComponentAvailable formulation detail
Ivermectin10 mg per ml
Clorsulon100 mg per ml

The product’s care focus.

  • A combination of two named antiparasitic ingredients.
  • The product description covers internal and external parasite-care contexts.
  • A 100 ml injectable format within the Valerian parasite portfolio.

Presentation, route and administration.

Veterinary injectable formulation; confirm the authorised route for this exact combination.

Product-specific directions

A complete numerical dose is not reliably established in the supplied information. The veterinarian should confirm the body-weight amount, route and course.

Build a more useful care conversation.

Prepare these details when discussing Valmectin Super with your veterinary team.

  • Identify the target parasite-care problem and the animal’s exposure history.
  • Confirm the combination formulation rather than relying on an ivermectin-only dose.
  • Check species restrictions and food-production withdrawal instructions.

Before you take the next step.

What should I request for Valmectin Super?+

Ask for the current product specification, the available pack size and directions for your species and market. For a commercial enquiry, include your organisation, country and the quantity or documentation you need.

Does a care category establish suitability for my animal?+

No. The exact formulation, animal’s condition and local product authorisation matter. The treating veterinarian should confirm suitability, administration and any applicable food-production withdrawal requirements.

For veterinary professionals. Product information is an overview; the current locally authorised instructions and prescribing veterinarian determine use. Pack presentation may vary.
